boundary.closed: The three-generation tree-level map splits exactly into five family-singlet coordinates and forty traceless flavor coordinates. CKM rotation transports the left-handed quark matrix without adding a coordinate, while the weak anomaly sees only Tr(3 c_Q+c_L).
boundary.correction: The AZ-076 null vector (1,1,1,-3) is B-L-type, not baryon number. Baryon number alone is weak-anomalous and is not a null direction at fixed c_WW.
boundary.scope: The corpus five-coordinate source quotient is a family-universal gauge-typed slice, not the complete 45-real-dimensional flavor-matrix current space. Its anomaly normalization must declare whether it is per-family or generation-summed; the latter is three times the former on a universal three-family source.
boundary.open: Full gauge/Yukawa RG evolution, finite weak matching, covariance, and physical amplitudes remain necessary. Traceless flavor directions cannot be inferred from a bosonic weak record and require flavor-sensitive records.
boundary.nextCalculation: Use AZ-081's source-complete correction: seek a gauge-complete differential amplitude whose (A_2,c_WW) shape is non-collinear with ctilde_WW, while profiling c_tt, k_U, ctilde_GG, CKM and hadronic uncertainties.
